zh: 她现在正在公园里跑步。
en: She {is running::run} in the park right now.

zh: 他现在正在吃午饭，你晚点再打来吧。
en: He is {having::have} lunch right now, so call back later.

zh: 我现在正在做晚饭。
en: I {am making::make} dinner at the moment.

zh: 天现在越来越黑了，我们回家吧。
en: It's {getting::get} dark now — let's go home.

zh: 孩子们现在正在游泳池里游泳。
en: The kids {are swimming::swim} in the pool right now.

zh: 妈妈现在正在买菜。
en: Mum is {shopping::shop} for groceries at the moment.

zh: 他现在正坐在窗边。
en: He {is sitting::sit} by the window at the moment.

zh: 理发师正在给我剪头发，我现在没法说话。
en: The barber is {cutting::cut} my hair right now, so I can't talk.

zh: 猫现在正躺在沙发上。
en: The cat {is lying::lie} on the sofa right now.

zh: 公交车现在正停在我们家门口。
en: The bus is {stopping::stop} right outside our house now.

zh: 我的手机快没电了，能借一下你的充电器吗？
en: My phone {is dying::die} — can I borrow your charger?

zh: 我们现在正开车去机场。
en: We're {driving::drive} to the airport right now.

zh: 他们这个月正在南岛旅行。
en: They {are travelling|are traveling::travel} around the South Island this month.

zh: 看，他们正在厨房里跳舞！
en: Look, they are {dancing::dance} in the kitchen!

zh: 她现在正在给客户写邮件。
en: She {is writing::write} an email to the client right now.

zh: 我们队现在领先两个球。
en: Our team is {winning::win} by two goals at the moment.

zh: 我们目前正在计划明年的预算。
en: We {are planning::plan} next year's budget at the moment.

zh: 他正在系鞋带，等他一下。
en: He is {tying::tie} his shoelaces — give him a second.

zh: 现在开始下雨了，带上你的伞。
en: It {is beginning::begin} to rain — grab your umbrella.

zh: 这些植物快死了，因为最近没人浇水。
en: The plants are {dying::die} because nobody is watering them at the moment.

zh: 我这周没在上班，我在休假。
en: I {am not working::not work} this week — I'm on leave.

zh: 我知道他现在在撒谎，他的说法一直在变。
en: I know he is {lying::lie} right now — his story keeps changing.

zh: 打印机现在什么都打印不出来。
en: The printer {isn't printing|is not printing::not print} anything at the moment.

zh: 你现在跟我们一起走吗？
en: Are you {coming::come} with us now?

zh: 你现在在用这台电脑吗？
en: {Are you using::you, use} this computer at the moment?

zh: 她现在没在听，她戴着耳机。
en: She isn't {listening::listen} right now — she has her headphones on.

zh: 她现在为什么在哭？
en: Why {is she crying::she, cry} right now?

zh: 会议现在刚刚开始。
en: The meeting is just {beginning::begin} now.

zh: 我们现在正在等公交车。
en: We {are waiting::wait} for the bus at the moment.

zh: 邻居们今天正在翻挖他们的花园。
en: The neighbours are {digging::dig} up their garden today.

zh: 他现在正在把买的东西放进车里。
en: He {is putting::put} the shopping in the car right now.

zh: 我目前正在存钱买一辆新车。
en: I'm {saving::save} money for a new car at the moment.

zh: 工程师们现在正在升级服务器，所以网站很慢。
en: The engineers {are upgrading::upgrade} the server right now, so the site is slow.

zh: 外面现在发生了什么事？
en: What is {happening::happen} outside right now?

zh: 他们现在不接电话。
en: They {aren't answering|are not answering::not answer} their phone at the moment.

zh: 公司这个月正在取消所有的出差。
en: The company is {cancelling|canceling::cancel} all travel this month.

zh: 目前物价上涨得很快。
en: Prices {are rising::rise} fast at the moment.

zh: 网站现在挂了，所以大家都很慌。
en: Everyone is {panicking::panic} because the site is down right now.

zh: 你现在在跟谁说话？
en: Who {are you talking::you, talk} to right now?

zh: 水龙头现在还在滴水吗？
en: Is the tap still {dripping::drip} now?
